text_block_list.text: When I stopped by the library to look something up, Meisho Doto and the others were there.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Is there really no hope for me anywhere~~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... Lady Shiraoki's divine revelations are absolute!
The results cannot be overturned...!
choice_data_list: You've got quite a serious look on your face.
You've got quite a serious look on your face.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, whoa, Trainer...!
Fukukitaru-san is doing a fortune-telling for me right now..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What a surprise! A fan living overseas reached out to me for advice, saying they're debating whether to pursue the path of an artist!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
However—unfortunately, Lady Shiraoki's divine message
was that 'The path to your goal is steep, and there are signs of failure!'

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hauu... That's tough, isn't it~...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, the result of this fortune
should illuminate the way forward...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's get translating!
Time to show off your language skills, Doto-san!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...Is it really, r-really not okay
to ask someone else to do the translation...?!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, I don't know how to put it... I can't think of a way to write it without hurting their feelings.
choice_data_list: I think you should just be honest about it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I agree! If we explain it vaguely,
it could lead to unexpected trouble...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Y-You're right. I'm so sorry, I'm so sorry!
To think I'd, s-say something that sounded like I doubted your fortune-telling, Fukukitaru-san... Hauu...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-Alright... I'll translate...! Honestly... I'll be totally honest.........!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. ...Um...
Well... no, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Um......
I-If you don't mind, only if it's okay, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I'd like to... write in this "proverb" too, if that's... okay...

Meisho Doto wrote down some English sentences on paper.
What was written there was—

『Every failure is a
stepping stone to success.』

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Every... file... Mmm?
What does this mean, I wonder!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
As they say in Japanese,
"Failure is the mother of success"... yes-s.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"A-Also, if I could just add
'Cheering on your challenge' as well..."
choice_data_list: Those are words that give me courage.
Those are words that give me courage, aren't they.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! ...When I was down after failing,
my parents encouraged me with those words~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Even now, whenever I feel down, I chant it in my head.
When I do, it feels like all my many failures are just a little bit, r-rewarded...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah! B-But please don't force it in!
Because of my random idea, i-it might end up misrepresenting the fortune...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Those words radiate good luck! Let's
add the English version, "Failure teaches success," too!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"A-Are you alright~?
...This is starting to feel a bit like a lecture~."
choice_data_list: Maybe soften the wording a bit...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If you say so too, Trainer...
T-Then I'll go ahead and add it~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's send this to the client right away!
Heh-heh♪ Shiraoki-sama is making her international debut!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I got a reply!
Please translate it for me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Umm, well...
She said, "Thank you. I'll take on the challenge without fear of failure!"...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Looks like the power of the proverb
really got through to you!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees...!

Meisho Doto looked thrilled
by the client's positive reply.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: R-Right, exactly...? Um, so then, so then...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
How about we add more of an explanation!
Like introducing Lady Shiraoki's past revelations!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You're right. It might also be good
to have an introduction or some footnotes...!
And so, after making all the revisions, what resulted was—a stack of report papers as thick as a short novel.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Do you think they'll read this part?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Even if they do read it, I'm worried the
fortune's results might not really get across...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah-wawawa! I'll do my best to fix it~~~!

After revising it countless times,
a truly satisfying piece of writing was finally complete.
